name: Partially Filled Vessel
summary: Tenaron Stormgrip gives young night elf initiates the Partially Filled Vessel in Aldrassil. It carries blessed moonwell water from Shadowglen toward Dolanaar.

sections.title: A Sacred Delivery
sections.body: Young kaldorei initiates gather blessed water from Shadowglen’s secluded moonwell. In Aldrassil, Tenaron Stormgrip pours a sample into the vessel for its journey across Teldrassil. More water from the tree’s moonwells must be gathered to tend to the island’s health.

sections.title: Onward to Dolanaar
sections.body: Carry the vessel south through the valley gates, then follow the cobblestone roads west to Dolanaar. The journey takes a young adventurer beyond Shadowglen’s protected nursery and into Teldrassil’s wider wilds. At Dolanaar’s central moonwell, Corithras Moonrage takes the vessel and directs the next part of the ritual.

faq.answer: The vessel holds pure water from Shadowglen’s sacred moonwell, poured in by the druid Tenaron Stormgrip.

faq.q: Why is it only partially filled?
faq.answer: Shadowglen’s moonwell supplies only the first sample. Caring for Teldrassil requires water from several moonwells before the vessel is full.

faq.q: Who do I take this vessel to?
faq.answer: Carry the vessel south out of Shadowglen, then follow the cobblestone road west to Dolanaar. Deliver it to Corithras Moonrage, who tends the town’s moonwell.

faq.q: Why is moonwell water being moved around Teldrassil?
faq.answer: Druids and priestesses monitor and nourish Teldrassil through its moonwell waters. Moving water between wells helps maintain their blessings across the troubled boughs of the newly grown World Tree.

angles.text: As a young night elf, carrying this vessel marks a passage from Shadowglen’s sanctuary to the wider work of caring for Teldrassil.
As a druid, you carry sanctified water in service to the Cenarion Circle’s effort to nurture the World Tree and inspect its health.
